title: analysis.table.summarize result
description: What each table's columns hold, and where the tables disagree. Every count is exact and every list beside one is capped: `this column holds three distinct values` is a fact about the table, and the same sentence under a cap that also bounded the counting would be a fact about the request.

value.description: A number for the scalar kinds, a string for `text`, and an array of byte values for `bytes`.

offset.description: Byte offset of the first record, in every source: one offset, because a comparison between tables read from different places would compare columns that are not the same column.

record_size.description: The size of one record under the layout every table was read with.

compared_rows.description: Rows compared across every table: the shortest table's count, since a row one table does not have is not a disagreement about a value. A row-count difference is reported once as a warning rather than as a difference in every column.

tables.description: One entry per source, in the order the request named them.

row_total.description: Whole rows the region holds from `offset` onwards, whether or not they were all read.

column.description: Which value-producing field of the record this is. A `pad` consumes bytes and is not a column, so the column index and the field index part company as soon as a layout has one.

field_offset.description: Byte offset of the field inside one record, so a column can be found in a hex dump without recounting the layout.

distinct_total.description: Distinct values in this column across every row read. Always exact.

values.description: The most frequent values, most frequent first and then by value so the order is total. Capped by `maximum_values`.

minimum.description: The lowest value, for a column whose values are numeric. Absent for `text` and `bytes` columns, where a minimum would be a fact about an encoding rather than about the data.

comparisons.description: Per column, where the tables disagree. Empty when one source was named: there is nothing to compare a table with.

identical.description: Whether every compared row holds the same value in every table. The answer a reader wants first, and the one a capped list of differences cannot give.

differing_total.description: Rows where at least two tables differ. Always exact.

values.description: One value per table, in the order the request named them.
